name: Shari (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Shari town emblem in orange and white: an orange winged ring beneath a white peak.
history: Municipal flag of Shari, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 21 September 1958.

features.role: Shari town emblem — an orange winged ring beneath a white peak
